query:
SELECT id, shareId, reportType, address, bedrooms, bathrooms, createdAt, 
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.revenue_estimate.annual') as stored_annual_revenue,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.revenue_estimate.range.low') as stored_low,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.revenue_estimate.range.high') as stored_high,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.property._revenue_source') as revenue_source,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.property._original_rentalizer.annual_revenue') as original_rentalizer,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.property._exact_match_comp_count') as exact_match_comp_count
FROM shared_reports 
WHERE shareId LIKE '%dzd2wg%' OR shareId LIKE '%dzd2wgdDnJ%'
LIMIT 5;
